sources.quote: TOI-715 is a red dwarf star located 42 parsecs (140 ly) from the Earth in the constellation Volans, very close to the southern celestial pole.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Dransfield et al. 2024.

sources.quote: It hosts one confirmed exoplanet, named TOI-715 b, a super-Earth orbiting in its habitable zone.
